cards.ex: I'm totally hooked on that new TV show; I can't stop watching it!
cards.exUz: Men o'sha yangi serialga butunlay qaram bo'lib qoldim; uni tomosha qilishni to'xtata olmayapman!
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga juda qattiq bog'lanib, undan voz kecha olmaslik.

cards.ex: I know I shouldn't buy more shoes, but I can't help myself!
cards.exUz: Ko'proq poyabzal sotib olmasligim kerakligini bilaman, lekin o'zimni tiya olmayman!
cards.uzDef: O'z-o'zini nazorat qila olmaslik, biror ish qilish istagiga qarshi tura olmaslik.

cards.ex: She's obsessed with Korean dramas; she watches them all the time.
cards.exUz: U koreys dramalariga o'ch bo'lgan; ularni doim tomosha qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida doimiy ravishda o'ylash, unga haddan tashqari qiziqish.

cards.ex: I have a serious craving for chocolate right now.
cards.exUz: Hozir men shokoladga juda qattiq ishtiyoq sezayapman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani juda xohlash, ayniqsa ovqat yoki narkotik moddalar.

cards.ex: It's really hard to kick the habit of biting my nails.
cards.exUz: Tirnoqlarimni tishlash odatini tashlash juda qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Yomon odatdan voz kechish, uni to'xtatish.

cards.ex: He needed to get a fix or he'd start feeling really sick.
cards.exUz: U dozani olishi kerak edi, aks holda o'zini juda yomon his qila boshlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Qaramlikni qondirish uchun narkotik yoki boshqa moddani iste'mol qilish.

cards.ex: He'd been sober for a year, but then he fell off the wagon.
cards.exUz: U bir yil davomida ichmagan edi, lekin keyin yana ichkilikka qaytdi.
cards.uzDef: Spirtli ichimliklarni ichishni to'xtatgandan keyin yana boshlash.

cards.ex: I have a weakness for chocolate chip cookies.
cards.exUz: Mening shokoladli pechenyelarga zaifligim bor.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga qarshilik ko'rsata olmaslik, unga moyilligi borligi.

cards.ex: He's a slave to his smartphone; he's always checking it.
cards.exUz: U smartfonining quliga aylangan; u doim uni tekshirib turadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga to'liq bog'lanib qolish, unga qaram bo'lish.

cards.ex: She decided to go cold turkey and quit smoking immediately.
cards.exUz: U birdaniga tashlashga qaror qildi va sigaret chekishni darhol to'xtatdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror odatni birdaniga, asta-sekin emas, to'xtatish.

cards.ex: He's addicted to the thrill of extreme sports.
cards.exUz: U ekstremal sport turlarining hayajoniga qaram.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli yoki hayajonli narsalardan zavqlanish, ularga qaram bo'lish.

cards.ex: She developed a dependency on sleeping pills after her accident.
cards.exUz: Baxtsiz hodisadan keyin u uyqu dorilariga qaram bo'lib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga jismoniy yoki psixologik qaramlikni shakllantirish.

cards.ex: For him, gambling isn't just a hobby; it's an addiction.
cards.exUz: U uchun qimor o'yinlari shunchaki hobbi emas; bu qaramlik.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani qilishga bo'lgan kuchli, nazorat qilib bo'lmaydigan istak.

cards.ex: I was trying to diet, but I gave in to temptation and ate a donut.
cards.exUz: Men dieta qilmoqchi edim, lekin vasvasaga berilib, donut yedim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani qilishni juda xohlaganda, o'zini tiya olmaslik.

cards.ex: The doctor said he was a hopeless case and there was nothing more they could do.
cards.exUz: Shifokor uning umidsiz holat ekanligini va ular boshqa hech narsa qila olmasligini aytdi.
cards.uzDef: O'zgartirish yoki yordam berish juda qiyin bo'lgan vaziyat yoki odam.

cards.ex: He was in the grip of addiction and couldn't control his behavior.
cards.exUz: U qaramlik changalida edi va o'z xatti-harakatlarini nazorat qila olmadi.
cards.uzDef: Qaramlikning kuchli ta'siri ostida bo'lish, undan qutula olmaslik.

cards.ex: If you're struggling with addiction, you should seek help from a professional.
cards.exUz: Agar siz qaramlik bilan kurashayotgan bo'lsangiz, mutaxassisdan yordam so'rashingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammo yoki qiyinchilikni hal qilish uchun mutaxassisdan yordam olish.

cards.ex: When she's feeling stressed, she turns to comfort food.
cards.exUz: U stressni his qilganda, tasalli beruvchi ovqatlarga murojaat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchilik yoki stress paytida biror narsaga tayanish, undan tasalli topish.

cards.ex: He had to hit rock bottom before he realized he needed to change.
cards.exUz: U o'zgarishi kerakligini anglashidan oldin tubiga tushishi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Eng yomon ahvolga tushish, eng past nuqtaga yetish.

cards.ex: Skipping one day of work can be a slippery slope that leads to losing your job.
cards.exUz: Ishga bir kun bormaslik, ishingizni yo'qotishga olib keladigan sirpanchiq yo'l bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Kichik xato yoki qarordan asta-sekin yomonroq vaziyatga olib keluvchi jarayon.

cards.ex: I got carried away shopping and spent way too much money.
cards.exUz: Men xarid qilishda haddan oshib ketdim va juda ko'p pul sarfladim.
cards.uzDef: O'zini nazorat qila olmaslik, biror narsada haddan tashqari ko'p narsa qilish.

cards.ex: She always bites her nails when she's nervous.
cards.exUz: U har doim asabiylashganda tirnoqlarini tishlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Asabiylashganda yoki zerikganda tirnoqlarni tishlash odati.

cards.ex: He's a compulsive gambler and has lost all his money.
cards.exUz: U majburiy qimorboz va barcha pulini yo'qotgan.
cards.uzDef: Qimor o'ynashga bo'lgan kuchli, nazorat qilib bo'lmaydigan istagi bor odam.

cards.ex: I'm trying to quit smoking, but it's so hard not to feed the habit.
cards.exUz: Men chekishni tashlamoqchiman, lekin odatni oziqlantirmaslik juda qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Yomon odatni davom ettirish, uni qondirish uchun harakat qilish.

cards.ex: He's been struggling with alcohol addiction for years.
cards.exUz: U ko'p yillar davomida alkogolga qaramlik bilan kurashib kelmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa bilan qiyinchiliklarga duch kelish, uni yengishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Collecting stamps is a harmless obsession for many people.
cards.exUz: Markalarni yig'ish ko'pchilik uchun zararsiz o'chdir.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday zarar keltirmaydigan, faqat qiziqish uyg'otadigan narsa.

cards.ex: I got so caught up in work that I forgot to eat lunch.
cards.exUz: Men ishga shunchalik aralashib qoldimki, tushlik qilishni unutdim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga juda ko'p vaqt sarflash, undan ajralish qiyin bo'lish.

cards.ex: Trying to convince him to quit smoking is a lost cause.
cards.exUz: Uni chekishni tashlashga ko'ndirish - bu yo'qotilgan sabab.
cards.uzDef: Yordam berish yoki o'zgartirish imkonsiz bo'lgan odam yoki vaziyat.

cards.ex: I spent the whole weekend binge-watching my favorite show.
cards.exUz: Men butun hafta oxirini sevimli ko'rsatuvimni ketma-ket tomosha qilishga sarfladim.
cards.uzDef: Bir necha epizodni ketma-ket, uzoq vaqt davomida tomosha qilish.

cards.ex: He felt powerless against his addiction.
cards.exUz: U o'z qaramligiga qarshi o'zini ojiz his qildi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga qarshi tura olmaslik, uning ta'siridan saqlana olmaslik.
